newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 371-day bonds bear 60 pct interest.
newsitem.headline: Romania 371-day bonds bear 60 pct interest.

text.p: Romania's 371-day domestic bond issue sold at par in a single price auction on Tuesday, with a 60 percent annual interest, central bank data showed.
The finance ministry's offer of 1.132 trillion lei was heavily oversubscribed with bids totaling 1.996 trillion from 16 participants at rates ranging from 35 to 200 percent.
The interest-bearing bonds, the first leu-denominated one-year paper issued over the past 12 months, have a face value of 100 million lei each.
The bonds' issue date is August 21, 1997. The interest will be paid on February 20, 1998 and August 27, 1998.
The next auction is scheduled for August 26 with 82 billion lei worth of 91-day discount treasury bills on offer.
